title: Fix Delete Story Diff And Output Never Loading
description: In compose algorithms Storybook, the Delete story's Diff and Output windows are stuck on "Loading delete result (...)" forever. Root cause: Delete.stories.tsx uses `diffRes.change.forward`, but `nativeDeletePieces` returns `DesignDiffOperationResult` where `change` is the `DesignDiff` directly (no `.forward`). As a result `designDiff` stays undefined and the loading error text persists. Fix by setting `designDiff` to `diffRes.change`.
summary: Fixed the Delete story's Diff and Output windows perpetually stuck on "Loading delete result (...)". Root cause: Delete.stories.tsx was reading `diffRes.change.forward`, but `nativeDeletePieces` returns `DesignDiffOperationResult` where `change` IS the `DesignDiff` directly (no forward/backward envelope — that shape belongs to `DesignOperationResult` used by flatten). Because `.forward` was always undefined, `setDesignDiff(undefined)` kept the loading error alive forever, and `outputDesign` fell back to `flatInputDesign`, so the diff never rendered and the output never applied the deletion. Fix: in Delete.stories.tsx line 66, use `diffRes.change` instead of `diffRes.change.forward`. The rest of the pipeline (`applyDesignDiff(flatInputDesign, designDiff)`) already expects a `DesignDiff`, so it now renders correctly. Other stories remain correct: Flatten uses `.change.forward` because it wraps `DesignChange`; CopyAndPaste uses `.change` (Design) and a bare `DesignDiff`.
